# proofback

> proofback maps reviewer feedback on a compiled LaTeX PDF (highlights, strike-outs, carets, notes, email notes, Word tracked changes and comments) to the exact file, line and character range of the LaTeX (or Typst) source. It tracks each item's status and replies across drafts in `.proofback/` inside the author's repository, and exports patches, an answered PDF and a response letter. Deterministic, offline core in Rust (native and WebAssembly). AI agents use it through an MCP server; reviewer text is returned as untrusted data. Interfaces: CLI, MCP server, browser app at /app, Node package and VS Code extension. Release notes: https://github.com/Amet13/proofback/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md

## Interfaces

- CLI: `proofback init|import|list|show|triage|resolve|confirm|suggest|patch|apply|sync|answer|letter|inline|docx export|sarif|stats|mcp|doctor|schema`, `--json` on every command, exit codes 0 to 4
- MCP tools (stdio): list_items, get_item, propose_patch, apply_patch, resolve_item, sync, export
- Item IDs: `pb_` plus base32, unique prefixes accepted

## Related

- [overfull](https://github.com/Amet13/overfull): pre-submission checks for LaTeX papers. A different tool; proofback starts after review.
